title: Declared base-image references (outputs/base-image-inventory.json)
description: ADR-0010 task V04, second artifact of contract iac-config-evidence. Each entry is a FROM reference as DECLARED in a Dockerfile, split into closed fields so no URL, credential or free text fits. No registry is contacted: nothing says the image exists or what it contains. Validated by secrets_iac_contracts.py because an output contract declares a single result_schema.

attempt_id.description: The NODE attempt that published this document.

source_snapshot_sha256.description: Intake source-snapshot identity; must equal the one in tool-results.json and coverage.json.

redactor.description: Identity of the publication-boundary redactor. A copy for readers: it must equal the redactor block of outputs/redaction-receipt.json, which evidence_redaction.verify_receipt pins to the running module.

reference_id.description: Ordinal identity: BI-000001..n in document order.

tool_id.description: Must resolve to a tool instance with a validated output in outputs/tool-results.json.

reference_form.description: Only a literal reference carries repository, tag or digest.

tag.description: A tag is mutable; it is recorded as declared and proves nothing about content.

location.description: Where the FROM instruction is. A location, never content: there is no column, offset, length, text or hash field.

path.description: Repository-relative normalized POSIX path taken from the snapshot listing (never from tool output), percent-encoded outside the pattern. A path holding a run of 32 or more hex characters is not publishable (a digest-shaped segment could be a per-value hash) and is withheld. Null exactly when path_disposition is withheld-unsafe-path.

path_disposition.description: withheld-unsafe-path: the path itself did not pass the redactor, so the record is kept and the path is not published.

start_line.description: 1-based. Null together with end_line for a whole-file fact.

citation.description: The tool-instance output this record was normalized from. The field set follows threat-model-citation.schema.json without its free-text members (note, line_range, index_record_id). tool-results.json must list this path for this record's tool with the same attempt_id and sha256.

producer.description: Producing job id; must equal this document's job_id.

sha256.description: Hash of the cited output FILE (bare hex, as in threat-model-citation). Never a hash of a matched value.
